title: TanawPamana
summary: A multimodal AI benchmark for recognizing Philippine cultural heritage sites, developed during a research internship at the Nara Institute of Science and Technology (NAIST). Ongoing.

title: Evaluating LLM Stance-Taking on Philippine Current Affairs: A Case Study on the Impeachment of Sara Duterte
summary: Developed a framework for evaluating LLM knowledge on time-sensitive topics such as current affairs. Final project for AI Safety Diliman's AI Governance Accelerator, in partnership with SIGLA Research Center.

title: TDR: LSTM-Based Autoencoders
summary: Tagalog Diacritic Restoration using LSTM-based autoencoders on homographs, with evaluation on text from Virgilio Almario's Sari-Samot blogs.

title: TDR: Transformer-Based Models
summary: Transformer-based Tagalog Diacritic Restoration with corpus expansion, linguistic analysis, and model experimentation.

title: BEA: Blue Eagle Assistant
summary: AI-powered university chatbot built with Streamlit. Answers Ateneo student questions using handbook references and policy context.

title: FIES Viewer
summary: Django web application for exploring household economic data from the Family Income and Expenditure Survey in CALABARZON, Philippines.

title: SIMS: Social Impact Mapping Simulation
summary: Java two-party election simulation based on Social Impact Theory (Nowak, Szamrej & Latané, 1990), with GUI and dynamic social influence modeling.

title: In Print
summary: Works published in HEIGHTS, Palihang LIRA anthologies, Bente-Bente Zine, and the Pambansang Hamon sa Pagtula anthology are available in their respective print editions.

title: Ang Pagtupad ng mga Robot sa Tatlong Batas ng Robotics
summary: Three poems on Asimov's laws of robotics, written for and about machines. Published in Heights 70(2), 2023; reprinted in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.

title: René
summary: A collection of digitally manipulated self-portraits parodying works by Magritte, each paired with a poem meditating on the act of editing. Published in Heights 71(1), 2023.

title: Ang Hindi Sinasabi ng mga Makina Hinggil sa Hindi Natin Maunawaan
summary: Three poems on singularity: initial, gravitational, technological. Published in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.

title: Mga Talâ Mula sa Klase ng Etika
summary: Three satirical poems written from the vantage of philosophical ethics. Published in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.

title: Ilang Paraan ng Pagkagunaw
summary: Glacier, Sinkhole, Missile. Published in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.

title: 21st Century Maligno
summary: Three poems on Filipino mythological creatures reimagined for the digital age. Published in Kalat: Palihang LIRA Batch 37, 2022; reprinted in Metro Meka Mega, Bente-Bente Zine, 2024.
